source.name: Lu et al., A Reference Architecture for Designing Foundation Model Based Agents (ICSA-C 2024)

mapping.source_purpose: Dialogue interface, multimodal context injection, and passive or proactive goal creators that collect and structure the context needed to understand the user's goals.
mapping.note: Interaction surfaces belong to L1; interpreting goals belongs to L3.

mapping.source_purpose: Prompt/response generator using templates and personas to produce prompts and responses aligned with the goal.
mapping.note: Prompt and runtime configuration within coordination.

mapping.source_purpose: Short-term memory (configuration, recent events, working context) within the model's context window; long-term memory (event history, knowledge and past experiences) outside it, moved in through memory retrieval.
mapping.note: In-context working state is execution-bound (L3); long-term knowledge and experience is reusable context (L5), consistent with I2.

mapping.source_purpose: Single- or multi-path plan generation with one-shot or incremental model querying, refined through self-, cross-, or human reflection.
mapping.note: Coordination; human reflection corresponds to conditional human interaction.

mapping.source_purpose: Voting-, role-, and debate-based cooperation among agents.
mapping.note: Multi-agent collaboration; the case uses one agent.

mapping.source_purpose: Task executor performing the planned tasks, using tools or other agents, and a task monitor managing queued tasks.
mapping.note: The source places deciding and performing a task in one component; the proposed structure separates coordination (L3) from capability execution (L6), consistent with I1.

mapping.source_purpose: Search, rank, or generate tools and agents, drawing on a tool/agent registry or marketplace.
mapping.note: Agent discovery is an L3 collaboration capability; the tool catalogue belongs to L6.

mapping.source_purpose: Input, output, RAG, execution, and intermediate guardrails controlling the inputs and outputs of models, retrieval, and tools.
mapping.note: Boundary input/output controls (L2), retrieval constraints (L5), and permitted actions (L6): resource-specific enforcement, consistent with I3.

mapping.source_purpose: Black box recorder of runtime data across components, continuous risk assessor of AI risk metrics, and explainer of outputs and rationale.
Supply-chain records of tools, agents, and models, used to refuse components of questionable provenance; co-versioning of model variants.
mapping.note: Provenance policy is an L0 governance decision; co-versioned model variants are managed by L4.

mapping.source_purpose: External, fine-tuned, or sovereign foundation models, optionally used through N-version programming.
mapping.note: Model access, selection, and provider policy.
